prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: single production character pose, anim_08_grandma_light_lamp.png, for the existing Chinese 2D animated short "来电".

Reference images: Image 1 is the approved Grandma turnaround identity and costume; Image 2 is the approved facial identity/expression style; Image 3 is the approved Grandma profile animation pose. Use these only as identity and drawing-style references. Make ONE new pose, not a model sheet. Do not reproduce the bamboo rods or standing pose.

Primary request: Same elderly Chinese grandmother, HALF-BODY RIGHT-FACING SIDE VIEW, seated with torso gently leaning forward, carefully lighting a lantern that will be composited separately. Her head and face must be fully visible, eyes looking attentively at the tiny lit match tip, brows gently concentrated, mouth calmly closed. The action must read clearly as Grandma carefully reaching to light something.

Pose and hand anatomy are the priority:
- Her anatomical RIGHT arm is the NEAR/CAMERA-SIDE arm. It reaches forward to the right at chest-to-lower-chest height. The right wrist has NO jewelry. The right hand clearly pinches ONE slender wooden match between the pad of the thumb and the side/pad of the bent index fingertip. The match shaft must visibly meet the two fingertips at a believable grip point. Middle, ring and little fingers curl naturally into the palm, with a simple readable silhouette, no extra fingers. The match projects forward to the right, almost horizontal with a slight upward slant.
- At the far-right tip of the match, draw ONLY a tiny pale yellow-white bright dot indicating the flame anchor. Do not draw a realistic or elaborate flame, sparks, smoke, a halo or reflected firelight.
- Her anatomical LEFT arm is the FAR arm and wears the SINGLE green jade bangle. It reaches slightly farther forward than the match hand, but lower. The left hand is empty, gently open and palm-up, a natural shallow supporting cup, as if supporting the bottom of a small lantern that is absent from this image. Make the thumb separate and the fingers relaxed and anatomically clear. Keep a clean visible gap between the two hands and their fingers. The left supporting hand should be forward and below the match tip, leaving generous EMPTY space immediately in front of the match and above the left palm for a separately drawn lantern.
- Exactly two hands and two forearms, each traceable back to its appropriate sleeve. Do not overlap their fingers into a cluster. Hands are completely inside the frame.

Identity and costume: same kindly capable grandmother around 70, gray-white swept-back hair in a LOW bun with the red-bead hairpin, thin round glasses, same softly rounded face, small nose and gentle age lines as the references. Light blue collared short-sleeved buttoned shirt with small white five-petal floral motifs; dark navy trousers only partly visible at the lower crop. One green jade bangle on the anatomical LEFT wrist only.

Composition: clean landscape-ish single-character illustration. Entire head/bun, torso, both elbows, forearms, all fingers and match fully visible. Crop below the waist at the upper thighs, suggesting a seated posture; no full-body standing figure. Character mainly in the left and middle; space on right for hands and later compositing.
Style: match the references exactly: hand-drawn 2D animation, clean dark outlines, flat opaque local colors, only restrained soft form shading. Neutral EVEN FLAT LIGHTING, face equally readable, NO warm fire lighting baked into the skin, hair or clothing.
Background: uniform solid light gray, clean compositing plate.
ABSOLUTE EXCLUSIONS: no lantern of any kind, no lamp, no table, no chair, no room, no scenery, no extra props, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no watermark, no panels, no decorative border. Only Grandma and the one match on light gray.
